description.text:
Master Mode, Instant ATB 1 & Diffusion Barrier 1 to user
Master Mode: Cap Break Level 2, Hero Boost +25%, Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast; If enemy gains DEF/RES/MND buff, chases with DEF/RES/MND -70% to all targets
Interval Chase: 10 single-target Lightning/NE ranged hybrid attacks, 50 SB Charge, Hero Boost +30/35/40/45/50% to user after 1/2/3/4/5 chases (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Lightning/NE piercing ranged hybrid attack at True Cap Break Level 1, removes Master Mode
